description: Submit -> Logistics review -> Approve/Deny -> Source -> Mobilize -> Deploy -> Demobilize -> Return -> Close.

args.userPrompt: A resource request (ICS 213RR) has been submitted. Route it to Logistics for review.
Logistics: validate the request â€” confirm the NIMS category/kind/type, quantity, priority and incident. Check inventory availability before routing for approval.

args.question: Does the Approving Authority approve this resource request?

args.subject: Resource request APPROVED â€” source and mobilize
args.body:
'

A resource request has been approved and is ready to source.

' + '

Request: ' + jobExtendedProperty($job, 'resource_request', 'request_title') + '

' + '

Incident: ' + jobExtendedProperty($job, 'resource_request', 'incident_name') + '

'

args.userPrompt: Logistics: identify and commit an available NIMS-typed resource to this request. Set the request status to Sourced and record the sourced resource.
Mobilize the resource and dispatch to the incident. Set the request status to En Route.
Operations: receive and employ the resource at the incident. Set the request status to Deployed.

args.question: Is the resource ready to demobilize and return?

args.userPrompt: Logistics: demobilize the resource and coordinate its return. Set the request status to Demobilizing.
Confirm the resource has been returned, inspected and restocked to available inventory. Set the request status to Returned.

args.subject: Resource request DENIED â€” review, revise and resubmit
args.body:
'

Your resource request has been denied by the Approving Authority. The request details, full audit trail and the reason for denial are below, along with a link to revise and resubmit it.

' + $job.description

args.userPrompt: Record the denial rationale and notify the requestor of alternatives. Set the request status to Denied.

args.question: Has the requestor revised and resubmitted the request for approval?

args.subject: Resource request MODIFIED and RESUBMITTED â€” re-approval needed
args.body:
'

A previously denied resource request has been modified and resubmitted for approval. The current details and the full audit trail are below.

' + $job.description

args.userPrompt: Resource request closed. Confirm the request status is Returned/Closed (or Denied). This completes the job.
